content: Admission Inquiry Academics / KSDS Computer Science & Engineering Krishna School of Diploma Studies offers a strong diploma-level foundation in computing with practical labs, skill development, and industry-focused learning. 0 Established 0 Faculty Members 0 Computer Labs 0 Research Areas LEADERSHIP NOTE Message From the HOD KSDS Mr. Pratik N. Patel Head of Department, Computer Science & Engineering hod.cse.ksds@kpgu.ac.in Welcome to Department of Computer Science & Engineering, KSDS The Department of Computer Science & Engineering (CSE) is dedicated for ensuring successful careers for its students. For us, this means creating deeper industry relations than ever before, forming a research culture from day one and ensuring seamless education using the best technology available anywhere. We strongly embolden innovation in research, teaching and  service to the profession, the local community and industry. Our faculty members and students are constantly motivated to excel and advance the state of the art in Computer Science and Engineering. The Department's outstanding infrastructure and highly qualified teaching faculty ensure quality education. The Training and Placement Cell ensures a bright future for its students. I wish all the students and faculty members a successful academic career. ABOUT DEPARTMENT Career-Focused Diploma Education in Computing 01 Department of Computer Science and Engineering is the oldest and fastest growing department since 2004. In the global market, India's Software Engineers have created a remarkable impact in Software industries and earned great trust and generated revenue for the nation. 02 Department of Computer Science and Engineering has been one of the most lucrative and competitive fields to study from the beginning because of its growing global demand. It is an excellent field that offers opportunities both in software companies and higher studies. As computing is extensively applied in almost every aspect of life, it has created massive  job opportunities for Computer Science & Engineering students. At the same time increasing demand and application kept its research funding alive, many students attracted to pursue higher studies. 03 Department of Computer Science & Engineering consists of centrally air-conditioned laboratories equipped with high configuration computers and servers backed by licensed software, high-speed internet connectivity through fiber-optic leased line and Wi-Fi. Excellent academic record with Gold Medals and University Ranks consistently secured every year by students under the guidance of well qualified, competent and dedicated faculty members. 04 The department maintains strong collaboration with industries and MoUs signed with many leading industries. Special emphasis is placed on the skill development of students and faculty members through industry experts to deliver expert talks, organizing competitions and workshops. The Department focuses on three major objectives: to create knowledge, to propagate knowledge and to offer service to society 05 The program offers a wide range of employment opportunities in both the national and international markets. The department promotes activities are planned and carried out, and is equipped with the morden PCs, software, and hands-on expertise for providing high-quality education. 06 It continues to be a top option among all applicants for admission to KSDS. The young talent who aspires to study, teach, or create in the field of computer science is warmly welcomed by our team. So join us by coming. VALUES & GOALS Vision & Mission Vision To create an inspiring and conducive environment for quality research and academic education in computer science and engineering and produce globally competent students with moral values, self-motivation, and technology proficiency to build a vibrant nation. 01 To strengthen the core proficiency in Computer Science and Engineering and through analytical learning. 02 To empower the students with the required skills to solve the intricate technological problems of modern society and also provide them with an outline for promoting collaborative and multidisciplinary activities. 03 To impart moral and ethical values, and interpersonal skills to the students.
